epics.title: MCP Server Infrastructure & Transport
epics.description: Core Bonjour-based TCP server that hosts the MCP protocol, plus the icloudmcp-server CLI proxy binary that AI clients spawn. Together they form the invisible transport layer all service tools depend on.

epics.title: Menu Bar Application Shell
epics.description: The macOS menu bar extra that owns the server lifecycle, presents the service toggle list, and provides access to settings and about screens.

epics.title: Connection Approval & Client Security
epics.description: Per-connection approval flow that gates new client access behind user consent, with a persistent trusted-client allowlist stored in AppStorage.

epics.title: Claude Desktop Integration
epics.description: One-click setup that writes the icloudmcp-server entry into claude_desktop_config.json, using security-scoped bookmarks to maintain persistent write access.

epics.title: Calendar Service
epics.description: EventKit-backed tools for listing calendars, querying events with rich filters, and creating new events with alarms and recurrence.

epics.title: Contacts Service
epics.description: CNContactStore-backed tools for reading personal contact info, searching contacts, and creating or updating contact records.

epics.title: Capture Service
epics.description: ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation tools for taking screenshots, photos, and audio recordings, exposed as base64-encoded image/audio content.

epics.title: Location & Maps Services
epics.description: CoreLocation tools for device position and geocoding, plus MapKit tools for place search, directions, ETA, exploration, and static map generation.

epics.title: Messages Service
epics.description: Read-only access to the Messages app conversation history via direct SQLite access to chat.db, using a sandbox exception and security-scoped bookmark for persistent access.

epics.title: Reminders & Shortcuts Services
epics.description: EventKit-backed reminders tools and an Shortcuts-runner for listing and executing user automations.

epics.title: Weather & Utilities Services
epics.description: WeatherKit-backed weather forecast tools (conditionally compiled) and a minimal utilities service for system sounds.

epics.title: iCloudMCP Fork & Rebranding
epics.description: Fork the upstream iMCP project, rename all artefacts to iCloudMCP, update bundle identifiers and ownership references, and set up the PlanVisualizer toolchain for this repo.

epics.title: CI/CD Pipeline & Developer Tooling
epics.description: Full CI pipeline enforcing lint, test coverage, Swift build, commit message format, and PR hygiene. Includes automated release workflow, branch protection with code-owner gating, Dependabot, and GitHub secret scanning.

stories.title: As an AI client, I want to discover and connect to an MCP server advertised over Bonjour, so that I can call macOS tools without hardcoded ports.

acs.text: ServerController advertises an NWListener on service type _mcp._tcp in the local. domain
Multiple simultaneous client connections are supported via per-connection actors
Incoming tool call requests are routed to the correct Service by tool name
When the app is disabled, tool calls return an explicit error message rather than hanging
The listener auto-restarts on port conflict (EADDRINUSE / NWError code 48) using a random port

stories.title: As an AI client, I want to spawn a CLI binary that transparently bridges my stdio to the running iCloudMCP app, so that I do not need to manage TCP connections directly.

acs.text: The icloudmcp-server binary discovers the Bonjour service within 30 seconds or exits with a clear error
All stdin bytes (non-whitespace-only) are forwarded to the TCP connection
All network bytes are forwarded to stdout, reassembled on newline message boundaries
MCP heartbeat messages (12-byte magic-prefixed frames) are silently filtered and not written to stdout
On connection close (peer reset or cancel) the proxy exits cleanly rather than looping

stories.title: As a user, I want a menu bar icon that lets me toggle the MCP server on/off and enable individual services, so that I control what data AI clients can access.

acs.text: The menu bar icon shows distinct On/Off states matching the server enabled state
A master toggle enables or disables the entire MCP server
Each service has an individual toggle; disabling a service excludes its tools from the server
The menu exposes "Configure Claude Desktop", "Copy server command", Settings, About, and Quit actions

stories.title: As a user, I want a Settings window where I can review and remove trusted clients, so that I can revoke previously granted automatic access.

acs.text: Settings window lists all trusted client identifiers
Individual clients can be removed via context menu or Delete key
"Remove All" button with confirmation alert clears the entire trusted list

stories.title: As a user, I want a dialog to appear when an unknown client connects, so that I can allow or deny access before any tools are called.

acs.text: An approval dialog appears for every client whose name is not in the trusted list
The dialog shows the client name, Allow and Deny buttons, and an "Always trust" checkbox
Approving with "Always trust" persists the client name to AppStorage so future connections skip the dialog
Denying closes the connection immediately
Concurrent connection attempts for the same client are queued and resolved together

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a notification when a client successfully connects to iCloudMCP, so that I am aware of active connections even when the menu is closed.

acs.text: A UNUserNotification fires when a new client connection is established and approved
Notification permission is requested on first server start

stories.title: As a user, I want to click a menu item to automatically configure Claude Desktop to use iCloudMCP, so that I do not need to manually edit JSON.

acs.text: "Configure Claude Desktop" shows an alert summarising the change before writing the config
The icloudmcp-server entry is upserted into the mcpServers map without disturbing other entries
The config is written using a security-scoped bookmark; an NSSavePanel fallback fires if no bookmark exists
"Copy server command to clipboard" places the full icloudmcp-server path on the pasteboard

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to list calendars and fetch events with flexible filters, so that I can answer scheduling questions.

acs.text: calendars_list returns all EKCalendar entries with title, source, color, and edit/subscribe flags
events_fetch accepts start/end date ranges with lenient ISO 8601 parsing (date-only and datetime)
events_fetch supports filtering by calendar name, text query, all-day, status, availability, hasAlarms, and isRecurring
Calendar permission is checked before each read; an error is thrown if access is not granted

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to create calendar events with alarms and availability settings, so that I can help users schedule commitments.

acs.text: events_create supports title, start/end, calendar, location, notes, URL, isAllDay, and availability
Alarms can be relative (minutes offset), absolute (datetime), or proximity-based (geo-fence enter/leave)
All-day events are stored at local midnight with correct day boundaries
The new event is persisted via EKEventStore and returned as the serialised Event value

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to look up the user's own contact card and search the address book, so that I can personalise responses and access contact details.

acs.text: contacts_me fetches the unified "me" card with name, phones, emails, addresses, birthday, and relations
contacts_search accepts name, phone, and/or email predicates combined with AND logic
contacts_create persists a new CNMutableContact with at minimum a given name
contacts_update fetches the contact by identifier, applies partial field updates, and saves via CNSaveRequest
All contact operations run on a utility Task to avoid blocking the main actor

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to capture screenshots, photos, and audio recordings from the user's device, so that I can analyse visual and audio content.

acs.text: capture_take_screenshot captures a screen, window, or application and returns a base64-encoded PNG
capture_take_picture captures a still image from the default camera
capture_record_audio captures audio for a specified duration and returns base64-encoded audio data
Screen recording permission is requested via ScreenCaptureKit; camera/microphone permissions via AVFoundation

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to get the device's current location and convert between addresses and coordinates, so that I can answer location-aware questions.

acs.text: location_current returns latitude, longitude, and accuracy after requesting When-In-Use authorisation
location_geocode converts a free-text address string to one or more coordinate results
location_reverse-geocode converts coordinates to a human-readable placemark

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to search for places, get turn-by-turn directions, estimate travel time, and generate static map images, so that I can assist with navigation and exploration.

acs.text: maps_search returns ranked place results from MKLocalSearch for a given query and optional region
maps_directions returns step-by-step route instructions for driving, walking, or transit
maps_explore uses MKLocalSearchCompleter to return typeahead suggestions for a partial query
maps_eta returns estimated travel time between two points for the requested transport type
maps_generate returns a base64-encoded PNG static map for given coordinates, span, and options

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to search Messages conversation history by participant, date range, and content, so that I can answer questions about past conversations.

acs.text: messages_fetch filters by participant handles (E.164 phone or email), date range, text query, and limit
The service first attempts direct access to the default chat.db path; falls back to a stored bookmark
If neither path works, an alert and NSOpenPanel guide the user to select the database file manually
A security-scoped bookmark is stored in UserDefaults after manual selection for future launches

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to list reminder lists and fetch or create reminders, so that I can help users manage tasks.

acs.text: reminders_lists returns all EKCalendar reminder lists with title and colour
reminders_fetch returns incomplete or completed reminders filtered by list and date range
reminders_create saves a new EKReminder with title, due date, notes, and optional priority
Reminders permission (fullAccessToReminders) is requested on activate

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to list and run Shortcuts automations, so that I can trigger complex user-defined workflows.

acs.text: shortcuts_list returns the names of available Shortcuts automations
shortcuts_run executes a named Shortcut and returns its output

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to retrieve current conditions and multi-day/hourly/minute-by-minute forecasts, so that I can answer weather questions.

acs.text: weather_current returns conditions, temperature, humidity, wind, UV index, and visibility
weather_daily returns a multi-day forecast with high/low temps and precipitation probability
weather_hourly returns an hour-by-hour breakdown for the requested period
weather_minute returns minute-by-minute precipitation data for the next hour

stories.title: As an AI assistant, I want to play a system sound, so that I can give the user an audible notification.

acs.text: utilities_beep plays a named NSSound from the system sound library
An enum of valid sound names is exposed in the tool input schema

stories.title: As the project owner, I want all iMCP references renamed to iCloudMCP throughout the codebase, so that the fork has a distinct identity and does not conflict with the upstream app.

acs.text: All user-visible strings (menu bar title, About window, dialogs) read "iCloudMCP"
Bundle identifiers updated to ksyed0.iCloudMCP and ksyed0.icloudmcp-server
UserDefaults keys updated to ksyed0.iCloudMCP.* prefix
Xcode project and scheme renamed from iMCP.xcodeproj to iCloudMCP.xcodeproj
CLI binary target renamed from imcp-server to icloudmcp-server

stories.title: As the project team, I want PlanVisualizer installed and configured, so that we have automated dashboard tracking for costs, stories, and bugs.

acs.text: plan-visualizer.config.json references project name iCloudMCP and repo ksyed0/iCloudMCP
npm run plan:test passes all 757 tests
.claude/settings.json includes the capture-cost.js Stop hook
AGENTS.md references plan_visualizer.md for document format requirements

stories.title: As a developer, I want automated lint and test checks to run on every PR, so that regressions and style violations are caught before code reaches develop or main.

acs.text: ESLint runs on all PRs to main and develop; merge is blocked on lint errors
Jest runs with --coverage; merge blocked if lines, functions, or statements fall below 80%
SwiftLint strict runs against App/ and CLI/ Swift sources
Xcode Debug build is verified on a macOS-15 runner on every PR
All four checks are required status checks on both main and develop

stories.title: As the project owner, I want branch protection rules and CODEOWNERS so that only I can approve PRs and no one can push directly to main or develop.

acs.text: main and develop both require at least one approved PR before merge
.github/CODEOWNERS assigns * @ksyed0; require_code_owner_reviews is true on both branches
Stale reviews are dismissed when new commits are pushed to an open PR
Force push and branch deletion are disabled on both protected branches
enforce_admins is false, giving the owner an override path

stories.title: As a release engineer, I want a tag-triggered workflow that builds, notarizes, and publishes a draft GitHub Release, so that releases are reproducible and do not require a manual Xcode export.

acs.text: Workflow triggers on v* semver tags pushed to any branch
Developer ID signing certificate is imported from APPLE_CERTIFICATE secret into an ephemeral keychain, cleaned up in an always() step
Scripts/release.sh runs the archive, notarize, and export phases
A draft GitHub Release is created with the notarized .zip; draft status requires owner to publish

stories.title: As a developer, I want commit message linting, PR size warnings, Dependabot, and secret scanning so that code hygiene and supply-chain security are enforced automatically.

acs.text: commitlint enforces conventional commit format (feat/fix/chore/docs/refactor/perf/style/test/ci/build/revert) on all PR commits
PR size check posts a sticky warning comment at >500 changed lines; hard-fails the check at >1500 lines
Dependabot runs weekly for npm and Swift PM packages, targeting develop

lessons.title: Always add a LICENSE file (no extension) alongside LICENSE.md
lessons.rule:
Create a bare `LICENSE` file (no extension) in addition to `LICENSE.md`. GitHub's license detection only triggers on `LICENSE`, `LICENSE.txt`, or `LICENSE.md` at the repo root — but only the no-extension form reliably surfaces the license badge on the repo page.
_Discovered when setting the MIT license: LICENSE.md existed but GitHub did not show the license badge until a bare LICENSE file was added._

lessons.title: PlanVisualizer install script does not copy all orchestrator files
lessons.rule:
After running `scripts/install.sh`, manually copy `orchestrator/file-lock.js`, `orchestrator/spawn.js`, `orchestrator/git-safe.js`, and `orchestrator/adapters/` from the PlanVisualizer source. The install script only copies `orchestrator/atomic-write.js`, causing test suite failures on the first run.
_Discovered during PlanVisualizer installation into iCloudMCP: 8 test suites failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND errors until the missing orchestrator files were copied manually._

lessons.title: Bonjour service name is not set explicitly; CLI filter is fragile
lessons.rule:
When using `NWListener.Service(type:domain:)` without a `name:` parameter, the advertised Bonjour service name defaults to the device hostname, not the app name. Any filter that checks for the app name in `String(describing: endpoint)` will fail on machines whose hostname differs from the expected string. Always set an explicit `name:` or filter on service type alone.
_Identified during codebase analysis (BUG-0001): `CLI/main.swift` filters by `.contains("iCloudMCP")` which is unreliable._
